description: Properties. Requirements 3.2.9-3.2.12 are not designed. A driver should be specifiied with different properties but this is not implemented. This fault can be found in many places in the design.
Overview information. The overview information is sent continously, not on demand as specified in the requirements. A signal "Traffic Overview" is missing. This fault can be found in many places.
Atomatic reject. There is not "automatic reject as in requirement 3.1.3.
Soon Available. The functionality for "Soon available" is missing. This is used in requirement 3.1.8.
Prioritise orders. It is not possible to prioritise and order. Requirement 3.2.3.

Estimated time. The information about "Estimated time" to be available  in the signal "confirm". The operator shoudl be able to estimate the time when a taxi will arrive to a customer. Requirement 3.2.3.
Allocate car. Requirement 3.2.4 and the design of allocate_car (3.3.1 i STLDD) do not correspind.
Cancel order. The signal "Cancel_Order" is missing. Requirement 3.2.4 is not fullfilled. No message to the operator. (4.1  in  STLDD). Manuel dispatch and cancel order.
Message to a group of cars. It is not possible to send a message to a specific car group. A message has to be sent either to one or to all cars. Requirement 3.2.5.
ACK is missing. Acknoledgement (ACK) is missing when text messages are sent. The system does not confirm that text messages are received and OK. Requirment 3.2.5.
Not Available. The signla "Not_Avail" is sent in wrong occasion. According to the requirements, a taxi driver is available already when an order has been accepted.
LogOut is missing. The signal "Log_out" is missing and a taxi driver cannot log out of the system.
Confirm Order. A ??taxi driver/operator?? cannot confirm an order. This fault is present on many places.
Bill. There is no signal to send the price to a taxi driver. It is also not possible to print out receipt.
Reset Alarm. A taxi driver can reset the alarm, which is not allowed according to the requirements.
Log in. The operator cannot log in to the system and does not get a message when/if he/she has been logged in.
Log out. The operator cannot log out of the system.
Detailed Position. Detailed_Position is not sent, i.e. when the taximeter is on, the car should send exact position.
Available is missig. The signal "Available" is missing, The cars do not tell the central when it is available after drivinga custoimer. The car should have send available.
Login Rejected is missing. The signal "Login_rejected" is missing. No validation of drivers occurs.
Taximeter signals. The signals "meter_on" och "meter_off" are missing between the taxt module and the central. The central should know when the taximeter is on and off.
Start alarm is missing. The signal "start alarm" is missiing.
Communication request. A signal is missing that should remove/reject a driver's communication request.
Taxi number. The taxi number is missing in order_struct. (Kraven saknar order number)
Indicate alarm. A signal to indicate an alarm is missing from the central to the operator. An alarm  signal between taxi and central is also missing.
Logged in parameters. The signal "Logged In" misses parameters.
Voice message parameters. The signal "Voice_Msg" is inconsistent according to the parameters . Sometimes 2 is used and sometimes 3 is used.
Login in parameters. The signal ???"Login"??? misses a parameter.
Reject Orders. A signal is missing for not confirming orders.
Confirm Voice. The signal "Confirm_Voice" is missing.
Start Voice. The signal "Start_voice" from driver should be "send_voice"
Start Voice in 3.4.2 misses one parameter.
Manual Dispatch. A signal to confirm a manual dispatch is missing in section 3.3.2.  Further, a signal cannot be marked for manual dispatch.
ZoneInfo. A signal to send zone info is missing in section 3.4.1.
Signals missing in table. Some signals are missing in the table, like for example, Ok.
Order. The first signal "Order" should be OrderOper. Further, one parameter is missing.
